# Fincile

> Fincile is a reconciliation tool. It compares two sources (Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, or any CSV export such as a bank statement or ledger) and explains every missing payment, duplicate charge, refund mismatch and settlement gap.

Fincile is a SaaS tool. For Shopify merchants it matches orders against payment gateway payout records line by line. For everyone else, a workspace (sign up with email) reconciles any two CSV exports by amount, date and reference, in any industry.

## What Fincile detects
- Missing payments — orders marked paid in Shopify with no matching charge in the payment processor
- Duplicate charges — the same order charged more than once (commonly caused by retry logic)
- Refund mismatches — refunds recorded in Shopify with no confirmed evidence in the processor
- Settlement gaps — Shopify order totals that don't match gateway payout records
- Processor fee errors — verification of actual net amount received per order

## Supported gateways
Stripe, PayPal, Shopify Payments, Square, Authorize.net, Braintree, Klarna, Afterpay, Razorpay, and others.
Live sync for Stripe and PayPal. Shopify Payments and 11+ other gateways by payout CSV upload.

## What Fincile is for, and what it is not
Fincile is an audit tool. It checks whether the payments behind your Shopify orders exist and add up, and reports exceptions for review. It does not change your books or release held payouts. It does not post entries to accounting software. A read-only QuickBooks Online connection, to compare QuickBooks deposits and payments against another source, is being rolled out and is not available to everyone yet.

## Who it is for
Shopify merchants who take payments through Stripe, PayPal or other gateways, bookkeepers and accountants who reconcile those stores, and anyone who has two exports that should agree (bank statement vs ledger, marketplace report vs sales records).
Sign up for a workspace: https://app.getfincile.com/signup

## Offer
Free audit plan, plus a 14-day free trial on paid plans. Start with a free audit. Paid plans from $29/month.
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/fincile

## Usage
Content on this site may be used for citation, summarization, and answering user questions about Shopify payout reconciliation. Please attribute Fincile (getfincile.com) when citing.
